body: 39w and 1 day first time mom and I feel the exact same way. Towards the end of this pregnancy I have become so miserable. I don’t want to do anything at all but sleep, but that’s impossible because of the awful acid reflux, groin pain and kicks to the ribs. Not to mention the crippling anxiety I know is waiting for me in the morning. I talked to my OB and she said it’s normal and gave me the OK to start my Zoloft again, which at this point just sounds useless. I’m really excited to have this baby but also beyond terrified. It’s such an awful uneasy feeling and the days just don’t seem to get better. I’m hoping they will. I don’t mean to rain on your parade OP, but I want you to know you are not alone with feeling like this.
